name: pro-pk
title: Pro-pk
description: A full-stack Next.js, Prisma ORM, and TypeScript web application with structured database models and developer tooling.

details.whatItIs: Pro-pk is a full-stack web application built using Next.js, Prisma ORM, and TypeScript. The repository incorporates modern developer tooling including PostCSS and ESLint for code quality.
details.whatIBuilt: Configured project architecture, type-safe database schemas with Prisma ORM, and integrated automated build and linting pipelines.
details.whatILearned: Deepened understanding of modern TypeScript application design, relational schema modeling with Prisma, and leveraging modern front-end build tools for rapid iteration.

name: ICT-THEORY-AND-LAB-FINAL-PROJECT
title: Walk with Confidence (ICT Footwear Platform)
description: A university final project featuring a multi-page HTML/CSS website with product galleries, reviews, and order form structures.

details.whatItIs: A multi-page website developed for the university ICT Theory & Lab final project. Themed around modern footwear, it includes home, about, review, product table, and order form pages.
details.whatIBuilt: Designed responsive semantic HTML layouts, pure CSS styling rules, image galleries, and structured table/form elements.
details.whatILearned: Solidified core web fundamentals, cross-page navigation flow, pure CSS layout techniques, and collaborative Git revision management.
